item.title: Gov. Ivey announces expansion of P-3 early learning initiative
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Governor Kay Ivey announced on March 24 that 35 new early education classrooms will implement the state's Pre-K through 3rd Grade Integrated Approach to Early Learning (P-3) initiative. This initiative is meant to encourage school readiness through bolstering early education. It supports the goals of Governor Ivey's Strong Start, Strong Finish [...]

item.description: UPDATE: The Walton County Sheriff's Office has confirmed a stabbing at Walton Middle School. item.description: A memorial mass was held at St. Francis of Assisi University Parish on the campus of the University of Alabama in memory of James "Jimmy" Gracey on Monday night.
